newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka bourse suspends Merchant trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka bourse suspends Merchant trading.

text.p: Trading in shares of investment bank Merchant Bank of Sri Lanka Ltd has been suspended until further notice, the Colombo Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
The exchange said the suspension had been made at the request of the bank, after the Controller of Exchange fined it 139 million rupees on July 21 for a foreign exchange violation.
In a letter to the exchange the company said:

"It is our apprehension that if (the trading suspension) is not so done there would be serious adverse consequences to MBSL and to shareholders, before MBSL can initiate and conclude a suitable and necessary action to have the order of the Controller of Exchange and the penalty imposed annulled."
The controller said it imposed the fine on Merchant Bank for violating Sri Lanka's Exchange Control Act during the sale of 51 percent of Kotgala Plantations Ltd in 1995.
Merchant Bank shares last traded at 15 rupees on Wednesday.
